answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the ocean is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sonnet of the next round.
